name: services/mailclient/copy_message
description: Create a copy of a given message. The new message will have status draft and will not contain any attachments.
brief_description: Create a copy of a message.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • message_id - message ID of the copy.
errors: • object_not_found - message could not be found; param_name is equal to message_id.
